correctness.rationale: The generator equations for E[X], E[Y], and E[X²−Y²] are independently derived and solved. The Itô area decomposes into the drift u E[X²−Y²] and a Poisson reset-chord compensator r E[bX−aY], yielding the exact rational current. The rational shape has derivative proportional to 1−u²−r², proving its unique maximum and all roots without numerical assumptions. Regenerative finite-moment cycles establish the asymptotic law. Exact symbolic checks, eight independent high-precision renewal quadratures, and three stationary-law sampling experiments passed.

value.rationale: The question is natural for full-trajectory area-current measurements of periodically reset nonequilibrium transport: how often does the current reverse under varying reset rate? A complete sharp threshold, exactly two possible reversals, and the universal product law for the crossing rates distinguish continuous gyrator circulation from jump contributions. This is stronger than an isolated numerical counterexample and does not depend on an unsupported heat-engine claim.
